column3: If the zombie apocalypse starts while you're on a farm, do not drive into town.
Without knowing it, you're already in one of the best places to survive.
But only if you don't make one very stupid mistake.
Jake's first instinct is to jump in his truck and drive to Wichita to see what's going on.
No, that's exactly where everyone is going.
Instead, Jake has about 30 minutes before the power grid starts failing.
His well runs on electricity, and when the power goes out, so does the well.
He has a generator, but starting it creates a new problem.
On a quiet farm, an engine can give away your position from hundreds of yards away.
30 chickens, 12 cows, 1 horse, and a dog that barks at absolutely everything.
Keeping this farm quiet is going to be almost impossible.
So he locks the gate, brings the animals closer to the house, and starts counting everything he has.
On paper, he could last here for weeks.
Someone was already inside the barn.
